assumptions.statement: The repository's provisional rough site and key-area polygons are used only to produce a coherent temporary evidence package.
assumptions.impact: Every dependent layer, area, ratio, figure, HTML file, and PDF must be regenerated when official polygons arrive; current geometry cannot support statutory or parcel decisions.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, road redline, setback, heritage, rail, ownership, municipal, parking, and public-service controls are not available in cleared official form.
assumptions.impact: The proposal records these values as unknown and offers process gates instead of invented controls.

assumptions.statement: Conceptual building polygons are program envelopes used to test spatial distribution; they are not surveyed existing buildings.
assumptions.impact: Retain, renovate, demolish, and new-build decisions require a building survey, ownership review, heritage assessment, carbon assessment, and professional approval.

assumptions.statement: No verified utility capacity, subsurface, drainage, energy-load, bridge, tunnel, or station-interface dataset is available.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure proposals remain interface requirements and pilot questions, not engineering feasibility conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Every AI scenario requires purpose limitation, minimum data, accessibility, human review, appeal, incident response, and expiry before operation.
assumptions.impact: Scenario locations are concepts; deployment is conditional on lawful data access, accountable operators, professional testing, and public-interest review.
